goals.1: Describing symptoms: Ich habe Fieber, Husten, Kopfschmerzen
goals.3: The steps of seeing a doctor in Germany
dialog.5.de.4.n: Health insurance is compulsory for living in Germany
dialog.6.de.1.n: mitbringen is a separable verb: Bringen Sie … mit
grammar.0.title: Steps of seeing a doctor (in Germany)
grammar.0.note: Most medicines are not available without a Rezept. Without a Termin the wait is usually long — call ahead.
grammar.0.rows.4.2: getting the medicine at the pharmacy
grammar.1.title: Symptoms — Ich habe …
grammar.1.note: No ein/eine before the name of an illness: Ich habe Fieber (not Ich habe ein Fieber).
grammar.2.title: Sie questions from the doctor and the reception
grammar.2.text: Doctors and receptionists will say Sie to you: „Haben Sie Schmerzen?“ (Do you have pain?), „Wo tut es weh?“ (Where does it hurt?), „Seit wann?“ (Since when?). You can answer in short sentences: „Ja, ich habe Fieber.“
quiz.6.why: No article before the illness: Ich habe Fieber.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order to make the question: “Do you have pain?”
